agents.purpose: Triage inbound support tickets and draft replies for human review
agents.dataScope: Support tickets + public KB articles only
agents.memoryPolicy: Session memory only; purge within 24h of ticket close
agents.networkPolicy: Egress limited to internal support APIs and approved KB
agents.approvalPolicy: approved; customer-facing sends require human approval
agents.identityPolicy: End-user or service subject on privileged hops
agents.loggingPolicy: Tool, policy decision, ticket id, subject id retained ≥90d
